subject: prd/plan-new
statement: Decomposition output always lands inside the structural envelope and every plan/v2 task carries a complete evidence-backed assessment plus exact mechanically derived vendor-neutral profile; no task-level `no_inference` or native dispatch identifier is emitted.
intent: versioned corpus covering every accepted assessment/profile value, consequence floor, promotion, planner raise, mechanical-looking task, wide refactor, fog, overlap, and oversize; each family runs at least 5 times per release on a decode-pinned configuration recorded in the eval report
fit_criterion: every required run passes structural validation; 100% exact output on unambiguous goldens; zero unresolved/irrelevant/contradictory/partial citation sets; zero missing demand, `no_inference`, native identifier, or under-floor outcomes; the report records required/executed counts and any failed run keeps its family red
